Magnificent square of Melitene: on one side the vestibule of the temple of Jupiter, on the other the threshold of the municipal palace. I sprung in the background great movement of People who moved to the meeting of the Proconsul, Callistene, and Felice, by opposite streets.
The scene is filled with People, then Severo appears, preceded by his Legions.
Callistene, Happy, Polyuto, Priests, Magistrates, and sayings.
